name: Dondoko Doon! ~Manatsu no Koufun-do C~
original_name: どんどこドーン！～真夏のこーふんどC～
source:
Somewhere in the mountains there is a village that lives its peaceful life and celebrates a festival. Main character visits this place to gather cultural anthropology material. With relatives help he finds some field work during the festival over these summer vacations. Surprisingly, he is greeted by samurai girl...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/08/vn-of-month-august-2004-sorauta.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
群山深处坐落着一座村庄，人们过着平静生活，也会举行传统祭典。主人公为收集文化人类学资料来到这里，并在亲戚帮助下，于暑假祭典期间找到一份实地调查工作。出人意料的是，迎接他的竟是一名武士少女……

[译自 [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/08/vndb-of-month-august-2004-sorauta.html]vndbreview[/url]]
